parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The enterprise ID, also known as the organization ID, in string format. You can obtain it from the Yunxiao URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/[OrganizationId].

parameters.name: workitemIdentifier
parameters.description: The work item ID, which is the same as workitemId. It is the unique identifier of a work item.
